# Diogo Fitness (Diogo Fit)

Diogo Fitness (Diogo Fit) is one-to-one online fitness coaching from Diogo Camera, based in South Florida, for clients anywhere in the world.

**Website: [diogofit.com](https://diogofit.com/)**
